meta.name: L - raise vault seed minimum to 1,000 USDG
meta.description: setParams on VaultLauncher, reversing batch B. Only minSeedEscrow changes (90 -> 1,000 USDG); the other four are passed at their current on-chain values so they are not reset. B lowered it to 90 to launch a vault cheaply, and it was never put back, so the whole cost of launching a vault today is about 90 dollars: the 10,000 ZOR bond alongside it is worth 16 cents at the pool price, which makes the escrow the only gate doing any work. 1,000 USDG is the value the contract was constructed with rather than a new number. The bond is deliberately left at 10,000 ZOR: a bond fixed in token count has a dollar value that floats with the price, and pricing it off the ZOR TWAP instead would read a pool holding about 570 dollars, so anyone able to move that pool could make the bond nearly free. Until ZOR has a market that cannot be pushed around for a few hundred dollars, the dollar-denominated escrow is the honest gate and the bond is a token sink. Simulated from the governance Safe: succeeds. Simulated from an unauthorised address: reverts AccessControlUnauthorizedAccount. Governance on this launcher is the Safe 0xc75e64ccf3ce6e2f40939ab58255681769bcf8c4, which is NOT the Timelock; the Timelock holds no admin role here.
